title: Six selected CHIME repeaters show no clear tail persistence between observed days
abstract: We test the order of positive fitted scattering tails in CHIME/FRB Catalog 2 release 20251231. Six repeaters have at least eight selected UTC days, with 127 days in total. The equal-source mean adjacent-day log-tail correlation is -0.0292. A within-source shuffle gives one-sided p=0.3203. Shape controls and a 30-day gap check give no clear positive order. A strict S/N and single-component subset gives nominal p=0.0378, but not after a five-test adjustment or shape removal. Artificial rank ordering with latent observed-day correlation 0.5 is recovered in 94.85 percent of trials. This is a conditional order test, not a physical memory-time limit. Positive-tail selection, long gaps and burst-model errors limit the result. No independent telescope record confirms a physical change. Code, aggregate evidence, source hashes and retrieval steps are supplied.

display.caption: Source-level adjacent-day coefficients and aggregate random-order ranges. N is the number of selected days. Ranges are not physical confidence intervals.
